arStrings.szText: At the {c_highlight}War Plan Table{/c}, create a {c_highlight}War Plan{/c} to purge the remnants of Hatred from Sanctuary.
Build your {c_highlight}War Plan{/c} by choosing {c_highlight}Activities{/c}. The higher the rarity, the greater the reward!
Complete all chosen {c_highlight}Activities{/c} to claim rewards from the {c_highlight}War Chest{/c}.
{c_highlight}War Plans{/c} grant {c_highlight}Activity Experience{/c} and unlock new ways to modify Activities.
